Title: Export API definitions from API Management developer portal

Body.Content: We released a new feature that enables API developers to export API definitions in Swagger and WADL formats from the Azure API Management developer portal. API developers can use these files to generate client-side code by using tools such as Swagger Codegen. They can also import these files into API client tools such as Postman and start calling the API in very little time.
